text: ca vūpasantā honti saññā ca vūpasantā hoti tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ appattassa pattiyā atthi vāyāmaṃ tasmiṃpi ṭhāne anuppatte tappaccayāpi vedayitanti . [51] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami .pe. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca sekkho 1 sekkhoti
